rules: Only one System Master portfolio-controller schedule exists. Owner chats do not create independent overnight schedulers.
Active owner lanes are discovered from SECOND-SHIFT-REGISTRY-001 owner_files every run; lane names are not compiled into scheduler authority.
Each run begins from live repository authority and current owner heads rather than chat memory.

The controller may continue already-authorized unattended-safe work but cannot replace the central objective, change topology/ownership, supersede material work, perform cross-owner canonical writes, bypass failed gates, force canonical refs or change permanent security policy without explicit user authority.
Workers use isolated candidate branches; canonical admission uses the shared work-lease and repository-writer fence path.
Completion, BLOCKED and STALE are continuation points, not shift termination, while dependency-valid safe work remains.
A lane is IDLE_VALID only with durable all-eight-rungs exhaustion proof.
A-01 remains singleton and executes only trusted exact subjects; generic portfolio reasoning does not require A-01 occupancy.
At 06:45 only bounded or checkpointable work is refilled. At 07:00 no new normal Second Shift work is admitted and an exact morning handoff is preserved.

automation_binding.title: System Master Second Shift
automation_binding.binding_rule: The automation is an execution binding for this repository contract, not a second source of product authority. If its prompt conflicts with live repository authority, repository authority wins and mutation fails closed.
